tt0304141.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
tt0304141.studio: Warner Bros. Pictures, Heyday Films, 1492 Pictures, Warner Bros. Entertainment
tt0304141.description: Harry Potter, Ron and Hermione return to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry for their third year of study, where they delve into the mystery surrounding an escaped prisoner who poses a dangerous threat to the young wizard.
